# Virtuosity Drums — SFZ programs (text only), CC0 1.0

From <https://github.com/sfzinstruments/virtuosity_drums>, commit
`9f04cf9a734527edfbb0a4eee1f674e45bbf71bc` (the commit Cantus's content manifest pins), by
Versilian Studios and Karoryfer Samples, released under CC0 1.0 (`LICENSE`, unchanged).

Only `Programs/01-basic-kit.sfz` and the files it `#include`s, byte for byte as published —
no samples. Round 37's SFZ kit import (`tests/padout_kits.rs`, ADR 0100 §7) reads them as a
file from outside: it is not written by Cantus.
